description: This file contains unit tests for the ActiveRequests class in the Rialto media server component, using Google Test framework. It tests functionalities such as inserting, erasing, and managing media segments and request IDs.

classes.name: ActiveRequestsTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for ActiveRequests unit tests, inheriting from testing::Test.

methods.name: getTypeShouldReturnUnknownForInvalidId
methods.description: Tests that getType returns UNKNOWN for an invalid ID.

methods.name: getSegmentsShouldThrowForInvalidId
methods.description: Tests that getSegments throws an exception for an invalid ID.

methods.name: addSegmentShouldReturnFalseForNullSegment
methods.description: Tests that addSegment returns ERROR when given a null segment.

methods.name: addSegmentShouldReturnErrorForInvalidData
methods.description: Tests that addSegment returns ERROR when the segment data is invalid.

methods.name: addSegmentShouldReturnErrorForInvalidId
methods.description: Tests that addSegment returns ERROR for an invalid request ID.

methods.name: addSegmentsOverLimitShouldReturnNoSpace
methods.description: Tests that adding segments over the limit returns NO_SPACE status.

methods.name: shouldGenerateGetAndEraseIds
methods.description: Verifies that IDs can be inserted, retrieved, and erased correctly.

methods.name: shouldClearIds
methods.description: Tests that clearing all IDs resets their types to UNKNOWN.

methods.name: shouldEraseAudioIds
methods.description: Tests erasing all audio IDs and their effect on getType.

methods.name: shouldEraseVideoIds
methods.description: Tests erasing all video IDs and their effect on getType.

methods.name: shouldAddAndGetSegments
methods.description: Tests adding a segment and retrieving it.

methods.name: shouldAddAndRemoveSegments
methods.description: Tests adding segments and then clearing them, expecting exceptions on retrieval.
